source_prompt:
# Instructions for accurately documenting reportable workplace accidents

1. Start with the incident records.
2.
completion:
# Accident Reporting Guidelines

1. Start with the description of the incident.
2. Include the date, time, and location of the incident.
3. Describe the nature of the injury or illness.
4. Describe any corrective actions taken to prevent future incidents.
""")

st = st.text_area("Your Input:", value=sample_text, height=300)
# text = st.text_area("Your Input:", value=init_text, height=300)
if st.button('Generate'):
    with st.spinner('Building your report'):
        summary = llm_sum(st, 'summarize the text and highlight the accident details and highlight corrective actions in detail  ', max_tokens=650)
        
    st.text(str(summary))
<eos>
